MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick adds streaming to my existing 720p TV, giving equipment I already own a useful new function.",
    "The memory card fits my repeated storage purchases for cameras and other devices, provided it is compatible; extra capacity is more useful to me than the bundled reader."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers, smart display, and smart plug introduce voice-control uses I have not shown a need for; buying power strips does not mean I want home automation.",
    "Another 16 GB Fire 7 largely duplicates my current tablet. The larger Fire HD 10 interests me, but I do not currently need to replace what I have.",
    "The 4K stick's headline features add little for my 720p TV, and I would choose one suitable streaming stick rather than several similar devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a broad range of Amazon devices, although their functions matter more to me than their shared brand.",
    "My frequent electronics purchases seem to have been interpreted as readiness to upgrade devices, while many purchases support equipment I already own."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility with my existing equipment matters: my TV resolution, memory-card requirements, and device connections affect whether an item is useful.",
    "What I already own matters alongside my interests: I have a card reader and a Fire 7, so related products need to offer a useful addition rather than repeat those functions.",
    "My purchases of mounts, cables, storage cases, and camera accessories suggest ongoing practical needs around using and maintaining my equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my electronics interests but gave too much weight to shared branding and upgrades, and too little to compatibility and practical additions to equipment I already own."
}
